title: Whole cochain right-derived unit before geometric mates
statement: For abelian categories A,B with chosen unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and K-injective resolutions in A, and an additive H:A→B, define its cochain resolution unit on P by H(QuitComp.inv_P), preceded by the quotient comparison from Q(H(P)), followed by the canonical right-derived unit at the homotopy quotient of P. More explicitly it is quotientCompQhIso(B).inv at H(P), then H.rightDerivedFunctorUnit at p(P), then H.rightDerivedFunctor mapped on quotientCompQhIso(A).hom at P. This generic construction involves no scalar coefficients or geometric direct-image comparison.

lean.statement:
def derivedUnit {A : Type a} {B : Type b} [Category.{va} A] [Category.{vb} B]
    [Abelian A] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wa} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{wb} B]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions A]
    (H : A ⥤ B) [H.Additive] (K : CochainComplex A ℤ) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ⟶
      H.rightDerivedFunctor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
